sources.label: Morphe patches for Android apps
sources.author: toidicakhia
patch_list: For TLS debugging: trusts user-installed CA certificates, skips OkHttp certificate pinning and accepts any hostname, so a local proxy can inspect HTTPS traffic. Not selected by default.

Sends Locket's original signing-certificate SHA-1 to Firebase Installations, Remote Config, App Check and Auth. Required after repackaging: Morphe re-signs the APK, and Google otherwise rejects the requests with HTTP 403.

Makes the app treat the signed-in account as a Locket Gold subscriber, enabling the Gold-only feature gates and replacing the paywall with subscription management. Client-side only: features validated by Locket's servers still need a real…
